scope: One client installation/database, several warehouses in one organization; independent core SQL accounting critic. No arena/opponent code read.
outcome: Expanded characterization passed; no confirmed accounting defect and no production fix. No passing characterization is labeled RED.

property_oracle.representation: Go int64 integer millionths, formatted as exact six-digit decimals; no SQL arithmetic or floats in expected values
property_oracle.checked: concurrent reservations sharing each warehouse balance; parallel manual release, issue and two expiry workers; exact balance and each document line; independent reserved/released/consumed event totals; SQL ledger reconciliation; replay after expiry preserves results and full accounting snapshots

numeric_boundaries.independent_sum_oracle: math/big.Int integer millionths across two warehouses; aggregate exceeds per-row numeric(24,6) and int64 micro range
numeric_boundaries.overflow: adding one micro to maximum rejects SQLSTATE22003 and preserves stock/document/reservation/ledger/operation/effect snapshots
numeric_boundaries.owner_import: NaN/Infinity/-Infinity rejected for both balance quantities and requested/reserved/fulfilled document quantities (15 cases). Existing finite-domain upper bound already protects these fields.

scope_atomicity: Cross-warehouse correction, same-ID command reuse against another warehouse and cross-warehouse balance references fail atomically.

mutation_campaign.faults: Rounding debit, credit or expiry to three decimal places; all produce actual behavioral failures, not setup/build/skip/timeout results.

parallel_backend_scan.checks: All Query sites close rows/check Err; context propagated; runtime values parameterized; identifiers fixed or pgx.Identifier.Sanitize; operation errors checked; ignored rollback cleanup errors intentional.
